about: The work list, in priority order. An item is done only when its proof test exists and passes: node tools/progress.mjs checks that the test exists, and the full check runs it. Work on one item at a time. Change an item's status and proof; never delete or reword an item to make the list look finished.

features.description: A fitness test finds every route that declares no response model, and says how to fix it.
<What the next item does, in one sentence a test could prove.>
